implemented_behavior: Operator-selected TrackingTarget is retained as visual target selection authority, not semantic identity authority.
TrackingPrompt supports FACE/BOX/POINT/MASK; FACE is represented by operator evidence plus geometry and SAM3 receives only the geometric seed.
TrackFrame/TrackSegment retain source frame SHA-256, confidence, governed geometry, and explicit propagation gaps.
TrackRevision is immutable; operator GOOD creates a new accepted revision rather than mutating the proposal.
NEEDS_EDIT and REJECT append immutable feedback and preserve the candidate revision history.
Session creation, revision save, and feedback transitions write receipts with actor, preconditions, validators, postconditions, error route, and recovery path.
SQLite compare-and-set prevents stale writers; idempotent replay is deterministic and conflict-checked before stale-base rejection.
Accepted revisions project to normalized Storyboard/BBOX geometry and deterministic OpenChatCut pixel regions only after operator promotion and source-media hash match.
The SAM3 adapter is injected and replaceable; CAE does not vendor upstream SAM3 source or weights.
limitations: The archive has no original Git metadata, so the baseline and implementation SHAs are local evidence commits constructed from the supplied snapshot.
Native SAM3 execution was not established because the supplied environment has no sam3 package and CPU-only PyTorch; no production runtime reachability claim is made.
The focused test module uses a test-only import fallback because the supplied environment lacks psycopg; this fallback does not mock SAM3 and does not alter production imports.
No API/UI integration was made because api/ is outside the allowed boundary.
No direct SuperVisual adapter was added; the accepted normalized Storyboard/BBOX geometry is the governed downstream composition handoff for a later authorized integrator.
Perceptual target correctness, semantic speaker identity, and final creative quality remain operator decisions.
